An & that would read as a character reference in a link destination or title stays literal

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<a href=\"?&amp;plus;\" title=\"&amp;plus;\">T</a>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
